notes.title: Donut Distraction now in 7 languages!!
notes.notes:
It's been a while since we made any updates but we've been busy recently and can now reveal that Donut Distraction is playable in English, Spanish, German, French, Portugese (Brazillian), Korean and Simplified Chinese!!

We've also added support for Windows Mixed Reality as well as squashing some bugs!  And since it's Christmas there's snow and santa hats of course!!
